Class Executor<O extends ISceneOps>

java.lang.Object
io.github.mcalgovisualizations.visualization.renderer.Executor<O>
Type Parameters:
O - the type of scene operations this executor can apply
public final class Executor<O extends ISceneOps> extends Object
Executes queued AnimationPlans against a scene over time.

The executor processes animation plans step by step using Minestom's scheduler. Each step applies an operation to the scene and may wait a configured number of ticks before the next step is executed.

Zero-wait steps are processed in the same tick, up to MAX_OPS_PER_TICK, to avoid infinite loops or excessive work in a single server tick.

    • add

      public void add(@NotNull @NotNull AnimationPlan<O> plan)
      Adds an animation plan to the execution queue.

      Empty plans are ignored.

      Parameters:
      plan - the plan to enqueue

    • startIfIdle

      public void startIfIdle()
      Starts the scheduler if the executor is not paused and no scheduler task is currently running.

    • pause

      public void pause()
      Pauses execution and stops the scheduler.

      The current plan, step index, remaining wait time, and queued plans are preserved.

    • resume

      public void resume()
      Resumes execution if currently paused.

    • isIdle

      public boolean isIdle()
      Returns whether this executor has no active scheduler, no active plan, and no queued plans.
      Returns:
      true if there is no work currently running or queued

    • setSpeed

      public void setSpeed(int speed)
      Sets the scheduler interval multiplier.

      A value of 1 runs every server tick, 2 runs every two ticks, and so on.

      Parameters:
      speed - scheduler interval multiplier; must be greater than 0
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if speed <= 0

    • onCleanup

      public void onCleanup()
      Stops execution and clears all queued and active animation state.

      This should be called when the owning scene/session is being destroyed.
